purpose: The KYC service receives customer ID details and document images, stores them in S3 and a PostgreSQL database, and sends the case to an ID verification vendor.

components.name: kyc-orchestrator
components.evidence: kyc-orchestrator is exposed to the customer app through the public API layer.

components.name: kyc-documents
components.evidence: kyc-orchestrator -> kyc-documents bucket (S3) holds the images

components.name: ID verification vendor
components.evidence: kyc-orchestrator sends name, DOB, country + images to vendor

flows.evidence: orchestrator -> kyc-documents bucket (S3) holds the images
orchestrator sends name, DOB, country + images to vendor
vendor result goes back into kyc-db, status = verified / rejected / manual_review
